description: Bounds of the ReAct repair controller (babeldoc/magazine/react/). Same convention as configs/detectors.json: every numeric parameter carries a '<name>_allowed_range' sibling of the form 'low..high', inclusive on both ends, and the convention holds inside the nested action blocks as well. 'actions' is the vocabulary a decision may choose from; a name outside it, a parameter the chosen action does not declare, or a value outside that parameter's range is a violation and the reply is refused. Each action declares 'issue_kinds', the detector kinds it answers for, 'max_applications', the ceiling on how many paragraphs it may touch over the whole run, its 'parameters' with a default and a range each, and its 'applicability', which is what decides whether a particular finding is one this action may act on at all. Applicability is deliberately stricter than detection: a detector reports what looks wrong and a repair has to be sure, because leaving a defect standing costs one defect and rewriting a correct paragraph costs a correct paragraph. For translate_orphan_lines that is two conditions. 'min_residue_ratio' is the share of the paragraph's script characters that must be in the wrong script -- a paragraph that is almost entirely the wrong script was not translated, whereas a mixed one is a translation that kept a name in its source form, and rewriting the second would undo a correct decision. 'orphan_layout_labels' is the closed set of layout labels an orphan carries: a paragraph the layout parser recovered outside every detected block, which is what 'fallback_line' means and the only way a paragraph reaches typesetting without ever having been offered to the translator. A paragraph carrying any other label was offered and what it renders as is the translator's decision, which this action does not overrule. 'min_source_chars' keeps a folio or a credit glyph from being sent anywhere. An action may also declare, at its own level beside 'max_applications', the numbers its own mechanism is bounded by. Such a number is neither a parameter nor a term of the rule: a decision may not set it and it selects nothing. 'contain_in_page' declares two: 'contain_min_scale', the smallest share of its set size a heading may be shrunk to before shrinking it is the wrong answer and the finding is escalated instead, and 'contain_margin_ratio', how far inside the page frame the ink is landed, as a share of each of the frame's own axes. The margin is the action's rather than the detector's because the two answer different questions: the detector says whether ink is outside the trim, and the action chooses how comfortably inside to put it, which has to clear the trim tolerance rather than sit on it. The two actions added beside the orphan one answer for the geometric findings. 'contain_in_page' slides a paragraph whose ink reaches past the page frame back inside it, and shrinks it about the centre of its own extent only where sliding cannot fit it; its rule admits a display block by 'contain_layout_labels' and a reach past 'min_overflow_ratio', which is at or above the share the detector reports at. 'resolve_collision' answers for two texts standing in one place and moves nothing in this version: the causes are heterogeneous and their answers are opposite, so a finding at or above 'min_collision_iou' is recorded for a human and nothing is written. Each term carries a sentence in 'statements', keyed by the term it states and carrying '{value}' where the term's own figure goes: the rule is applied from the numbers and stated to the deciding model from these sentences, so a request cannot describe a filter other than the one it is feeding. Every term must carry one and every statement must name a term. 'max_iterations' bounds the detect-decide-act-recheck loop, 'decide_max_attempts' bounds how many times one iteration's decision may be asked for before the iteration is abandoned, and the remaining numbers bound what one request is allowed to carry.

translate_orphan_lines.description: Send the text of an orphan line through the translation engine and write the answer back into the paragraph, then lay that paragraph out again.

statements.min_residue_ratio: its evidence reports residue_ratio at or above {value}
statements.min_source_chars: the text the page renders for it is at least {value} characters long
statements.orphan_layout_labels: its evidence reports layout_label as one of: {value}

contain_in_page.description: Slide a paragraph whose laid out characters reach past the page frame back inside it, shrinking it about the centre of its own extent only where sliding alone cannot fit it, and escalate instead of shrinking past the declared floor.

statements.contain_layout_labels: its evidence reports layout_label as one of: {value}
statements.min_overflow_ratio: its evidence reports overflow_ratio at or above {value}

resolve_collision.description: Record two texts standing in one place for a human to look at. This version writes nothing: the causes of an overlap are heterogeneous and their answers are opposite, so a finding is escalated rather than acted on.

statements.min_collision_iou: its evidence reports iou at or above {value}
